answer: Reputation decays by a fixed delta of 5% each idle epoch, so a sybil stockpile cannot rest at its zenith. Each identity must complete three verified tasks per epoch to hold its rank; missed work triggers decay until it works again. A farm's idle dune of parked accounts erodes each epoch instead of waiting for an attack. The k-th fake identity costs a k-th separate stream of real work: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 task streams per epoch, while an honest agent maintains one. Renting idle reputations fails, because rented history keeps decaying unless the renter supplies fresh work.
